items.value: Strategy, creative and lead capture as one system, with qualification at the form.
We plan the campaign, make the creative and build the lead capture as one system. Then we judge it on leads that turn into business, not on clicks.
Strategy, creative, lead forms and reporting
A cheap click is not a lead. A lead is not a sale. We build the ad, the form and the follow up together, so the money goes toward the last one.
Spending on ads and not sure what it brings?
Who buys, where they are, what makes them ask. For Highmark that meant Ahmedabad corridor by corridor, not one blanket city campaign.
Reels, ad videos and static ads shot and edited by our own team, so the ad looks like your business.
A few questions on the lead form sort serious buyers from the curious, before your team picks up the phone.
Meta and Google, each for its job
Meta reaches people who are not looking yet. Google Search catches people already typing what you sell.
Two ad sets can look different on clicks and still both earn their budget. We decide on leads and bookings.
Numbers come from your own ad account. If a month was bad, the report says it was bad.
Numbers from the clients' own accounts
Highmark Realty launch ad for a 3BHK on SP Ring Road
A new channel partner with no clients, no leads and no track record. The first campaign brought 159 leads. Campaign after campaign took them past 5,000.
SVJ ArchInterió interior project used in their campaigns
Our longest running client. Five years of Meta ads and lead funnels for an interior studio that grew from two people to more than ten.
Send us your ad account. We tell you where the money is leaking, before you pay us anything.
Audience, offer, form questions and the creative to carry them.
Start with a test budget, judge on leads, then put money behind what works.
What ran, what it cost, what it brought in. Straight from your account.
Do you run Google ads as well as Meta?
Yes. Meta finds people before they search. Google Search catches them when they do. Most businesses need one more than the other, and we will tell you which.
It depends on your ticket size and how fast you follow up. SVJ ArchInterió spends more than five lakh a year, but they built to that over five years rather than starting there.
Do you make the ad creative?
Yes. Reels, videos and static ads are shot and edited in-house, so the ad, the landing page and the post all match.
You do. The account and the payment method stay in your name. Reporting comes from that account, not a dashboard we control.
How do you stop junk leads?
We qualify at the form instead of after the call. A few questions on the form mean your team spends its hours on people who can actually buy.
Send us your site or your ad account. We will tell you where the money is leaking, before you pay us anything.
Hi Digitorium, I want to talk about Meta or Google ads.
